prompt:
Production pixel-art correction, transparent sheet with THREE full-body small sprites in one row, equal cells. Same brigand character as reference1: cropped SOLID dark navy hair without highlights, blue-purple sleeveless tunic, mauve belt sash, dark trousers and boots, compact short-handled AXE. Six matte colors only (#172638 #4f4f7d #bbc1d6 #dda77d #373e64 #a394b1), no glow, no highlights, no gradients.
POSES MUST BE DIFFERENT FROM EXTENDED-STRIDE SOURCE:
1. Facing RIGHT true profile, CLOSED WALKING STEP. BOTH knees and boots close together directly under pelvis. Supporting FAR foot at hip x-position; NEAR leg bent, knee lifted a little, near boot passing just behind support leg. Overall foot spread NARROW, at most half shoulder width. No long forward stride. Axe held near chest in front, blade screen RIGHT, handle in gripping hand.
2. Facing LEFT true profile, CLOSED WALKING STEP. BOTH boots close underneath hips, near boot passing beside support leg, narrow foot spread. Same hunch and torso size. Axe held close in front, blade screen LEFT.
3. Facing directly FRONT, walking second phase. The character's RIGHT hand on viewer's LEFT firmly holds the axe beside LEFT edge of chest, blade is at SCREEN LEFT, absolutely NOT screen right. SCREEN LEFT boot steps forward/lower, SCREEN RIGHT boot lifted and tucked back. Match reference1 bottom-left character except alternate legs. It must keep axe in that same hand.
For all, preserve source proportions and the same head/neck and waist-center positions from reference1. No entire body bounce. Reference2 contains original tiny action poses; use the CLOSED-STEP pose for side second phases (row2col4 and row3col4). Reference1 is character design only. Empty generous margins, full feet and axe visible, true transparent background, NO drop shadow, NO colored backdrop, NO smoke/glow, no labels or grid.
